thesis: Understanding requires justified representations of consequences rather than merely matching descriptions.

ideas.statement: A useful representation preserves the dependencies needed to continue a system and justifies its shortcuts.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A mechanism and a storyteller can initially emit identical descriptions; blocking the ball probes their dependencies.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The program neither proves a metaphysical difference nor requires a short universal description.
